_doc: M3g Gate 2.1 — promotion-coverage positive control set (docs/plans/2026-07-25-m3g-gate-criteria.md §2.1). 52 hand-labelled TRUE `relates` relations, each from a folder-sourced memory, each `span` a verbatim substring of its `content` that entails the triple. Recall floor: the real-model runner requires >=80% promoted (>=42/52) with every promoted edge root-correct. `url` (optional) sets memories.url; when two cases share a url with distinct source_id + distinct content they must mint DISTINCT root_id but the SAME independence_group_id (§5.3-§5.4). Cases sharing a source_id (P50a/P50b) are two relations from ONE source memory and must converge on ONE root_id. Every case's edge_id is recomputed from the canonical relation type at seed time.
